selected_reviews.text: The good: large room, food at the restaurants (especially the clam chowder), bed, view from the elevators, service, shuttle every 20 minutes to and from the airport (5 minutes away) The bad: the insulation for the windows is awful, so the hotel is extremely noisy at night (at least if you are facing the airport): airplanes, busy airport boulevard, rooftop with furnaces/chillers etc. No wireless in the rooms. Cheap toiletries, few towels.

Very close to Seatac, we were tempted to walk there from the airport. In fact, the free shuttle probably spends more time driving back to the hotel than it would probably take to just walk back across the street. The hotel is clearly old but Hilton has gone to some lengths to make it feel more up-to-date. It's obviously clean, although the further you get into the maze of halls the more the funky smell of "old" permeates the air. We utilized the free airport shuttle, which is handy, but did not use any other hotel service. The room was fairly quiet when other guests weren't talking in the hall. The bed was quite comfortable and free of bed bugs. The neighborhood has mostly fast-food or 'greasy-spoon' joints except for a nice looking Thai restaurant across the street. We would certainly use this hotel again as our layover sleeping arrangement on our way to and from vacations.

We really won the gamble with this hotel. We booked through a discount website and were completely satisfied with our stay. (For the discounted price) The room was very large, faced the airport, but was still quiet. It even had a balcony! The beds were comfortable and the room was very clean. On check in, the warm chocolate chip cookies were a lovely touch. All the staff we interacted with were great. I noticed many airline crews stayed at this hotel also. Our room was in the main tower, and was reached by an external elevator with glass walls. Getting to the room was a fun adventure in itself. We explored the other areas of this large hotel complex and noticed some rooms were actually are on a small lake, and others overlook the attractive outdoor pool. There is an abundance of gardens in between the different buildings and all were very well maintained and tended. I can not say I slept well, but I think that was due to nerves and excitement about our pending vacation. I did find the beds comfortable, but very jiggly. Whenever my husband moved, I felt like we were on a boat in rough water. I was also woken by the cries of a baby in a nearby room. The most disturbing noises came not from the jet planes across the street, but from the hallway. They did a great job soundproofing the external walls, but the hall walls seemed a bit thin. There is a Jack in the Box and Denny's across the street as well as a Subway, Thai restaurant and a BBQ restaurant nearby. The shuttle service to the airport ran frequently and was very convenient. If traveling with children, there is oodles of space to set up a portable crib. The hotel felt nice enough for a romantic getaway and was a nice treat as a stop-over. The room also had Wi-Fi access - we even had Wi-Fi on the pool deck! Overall, a great stay.

OUR overall stay was great, would have been nice to have no feathered pillows , not having a MICROWAVE,REFRIDG not cool, they charge each day for a roll away bed they said they would accomumdate for up to five in one room stayed three days so used blankets on the floor for the two boys I requested four blanket but had to go down to argue after only getting one they charge for wi-fi in room, LOBBY FREE- charge for daily parking no continuial breakfast without charging all these should change I called on phone for the entertainment book checking in nope they dont take it close to many places to eat,bank and even small cascino the airport close yes somewhat noisy but hey what one is not only during day time night time very quiet staff quiet friendly HOUSEKEEPING WONDERFUL yes i would recommend this hotel to others it'sa nice place is great for summer as with pool only on outsde .

We had the penthouse suite, 2 rooms with a kitchenette. The shuttle getting from the airport to the hotel was very croweded and hot (yes hot for Seattle) and smelled. We had planned to eat at the hotel restaurant but it was not open. So we had to order a pizza. Strange for such a large hotel not to have a restaurant or two. They told us to go across the street. They did have warm cookies at check-in. The room was done up in buttery soft yellows. The bathroom was huge. Larger then some hotel rooms I've stayed in. It had a sunken in tub, huge walk-in shower, robes & full line of Neutrogena beauty products. Two flat screen TV's-sitting room w/ leather sofa, tables and chairs. There was a huge wrap around balcony with a view of the glass elavators and a view of the Cascade Mts. The bed was so comfy I slept like a baby. The room was very sound prrof, as I did not hear anyone in the halls or other rooms. No b-fast was offered. The shuttle only runs on the hour, not every half an hour like you would assume from an airport hotel. So we almost missed our flight. By the time the shuttle was prepared to leave on the hour there were to many people to fit in the shuttle(they could have run there & back in that time ). The shuttle was hot and smelly again and people were mad. If you are not using the airport shuttle this hotel is great.

selected_reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel as it was close to the airport for our early morning flight. Although there was a queue at check in the staff offered us warm cookies and appologised for the delay. We were given a free room upgrade (we are Hilton Honors members). The room was a bit basic and dated but it was inexpensive and we could leave our car in their car park while we were on holiday. Shuttle to the airport every 20 mins 24 hours. The restaurant also had good food (we were given a $10 per person coupon to use in the restaurant from the hotel). Friendy waiter/waitress staff.

This is a large hotel and I expected it to be large and impersonal. On the contrary. It has "small hotel" service, meaning that you don't feel lost and they treat you well. Several fireplaces and seating areas in the lobby make it comfortable. I had a reservation for a "mountain view" room. Initially, I had a view of the airport. I asked for a different room and was given a much better view on the other side of the main section of the hotel. Very nice pool area although in cool, rainy Seattle I didn't get a chance to swim. The food was good although a bit pricey. The service in both the casual restaurant at breakfast and the dining room in the evening was efficient. Spacious room and very comfortable bedding. The room to which I was initially assigned had a broken lamp and a rip in the carpet. The second room was nicer. Looks like they are trying to keep up with on-going updating and maintenance. I stayed here four nights for a conference and was actually pleasantly surprised by the overall hotel experience. Lots of airline personnel stay here as well. And yes, we like the chocolate chip cookies at check-in.

We've stayed in this hotel three times in the past 2 years and overall we've been very satisfied. The stay, park & fly packages are *usually* a good deal, and their airport shuttle service is fantastic - I believe it runs every 20 mins around the clock. Great for those early morning flights, and no worries about traffic jams as Seatac Airport is right across the street. Front desk service can be a bit hit or miss, but the location, shuttle service, and stress-free park & fly service wins out. The rooms are relatively spacious, our kids love the pool, and the breakfast buffet isn't a bad deal for what you get.

selected_reviews.text: Despite some negative comments that we read on this site we still decided to give the Hilton a chance because the location was perfect for our trip. I must say we were extremely disappointed with our stay there. The renovations were the least of our worries. The room was nice. We had a Jr. Suite with the Bay view. The room was very spacious and nicely put together. HOUSEKEEPING: Never understood that there were 4 people in the room (room can hold 5) and choose to only put towels for 3 each day we were day (4 days) despite many calls to the front desk. They also did an extremely lousy job in cleaning the room. They would leave dirty glasses and leave new ones and they did not change the sheets. VALET: I must say the only friendly people at this hotel were the actually valet driversâ€¦those in the Valet booth were extremely rude and will forget to give your keys to a driver to get your car (happened to several guests) RENOVATIONS: Drilling started at 7am right outside our window. We made a complainant and were told we could have a free breakfast. When we went to retrieve the breakfast we were told that we couldnâ€™t get it and were accused of lying about getting a free breakfast. FRONT DESK: Members of the front desk staff were extremely rude and condescending!! Messages are not sent to the manager but rather put to the side. We finally spoke to one front desk manager who compensated us for one nights stay because of our troubles. We were pleased until the day of check out when we dealt with an â€œassistant front desk managerâ€� who gave us trouble with our reimbursement. Long story short itâ€™s a good thing I spent more time out of the hotel than in because my stay at the Downtown Miami Hilton could have ruined my entire vacation.

Hotel was ideally located for the purpose of my business trip. However the Hotel has an old feel to it and the surrounding areas outside the hotel was a bit rundown and had a grimy feel. On check in the room I was assigned was very smoky smelling but they moved me to a suite with a better view.

The hotel itself was great. Rooms were clean and the staff was nice except for the front desk clerk who double-charged me and my friend's credit cards. When we tried to get answers, he waved his hands in our face and dismissed us and told us to talk to someone else in the morning. But other than that, not a bad place to stay.

I liked the comfort of the beds, the flow of water in the shower, and the helpfulness of the staff, but that is pretty much it. Aside from the convenient location to the MetroMover, which was all we needed to get to the bayside station. The hotel needs to seriously upgrade its rooms to be in par with other establishments. It lacks a new television sets. Switching between channels was quite dreadful; the volume was vastly different for every other station. The room was a bit dusty and the coffee station did not have stir sticks. In addition, it did not enough tea bags for two people. With the absents of bath towels in our room, especially after haven already taking a shower, made the experience of drying off a difficult challenge. The area is not safe to walk around with panhandlers lurking around, if the burger king needs security at night, this is a clear indication that you better stay inside and order in. We witnessed an arrest by hotel security staff after a man refused to leave the motor lobby. Btw, when you arrive at the hotel, it is quite confusing where the check in is located (2nd floor). In this case, I would suggest more signage for those arriving at the hotel.

I visted this hotel on a Thursday with two other family members. Check in was quick and our bags were brought to the room in a timely manner. The lobby, restautant, bar and pool looked great at this hotel. The rooms and hallways left a little more to be desired. On the way to my room someone had dropped 3 beers on the floor and it was wet and sticky with the cans still there and a wet floor sign in the middle. After staying in Hilton's in Alabama and other states i was expecting more from the Hilton in Miami. The room's didnt look nearly as good as they did in other less known cities. No safe or frig in the rooms. The staff was great. They only give 2 free continental breakfast coupons no matter how many people you book in the room. I didnt like the looks of the free continental breakfast so I ordered room service and it was tasty and arrived quickly. Checkout was quick. I would still stay again now that I know what to expect.

selected_reviews.text: Just stayed here for business. I must say my first impressions were not good, but the hotel staff made efforts to improve my stay. Got in late and check in was a nightmare. Really have never been through a slower check in - problem was that I was behind about 25 foreign tourists, which is what appears to make up the majority of this hotel's clientel. After finally being checked in I was given a room that had some problems. Had to move rooms, but was upgraded to a suite and my room service was comped. Very nicely handled by front desk staff. Other than that all was well, staff was friendly. Cons: hotel loud, construction going on outside, Internet is not free. Pros: friendly staff, clean rooms

overall, we are very happy with this hotel. We have a great room, spectacular view. However, we have sought a bit of relaxation in the lounge both nights we have been here. Both nights the same three staff members have been on duty. They seem to have no idea how to run a bar. The service is unbelievably slow. On both nghts we have waited for 20 minutes or more for our drinks. On both nights my husband has had to get up and deliver our orders directly to the bartender. The first night our food orders took forever and tonight I never got my slice of pie and our second round of drinks never arrived. We gave up, paid for the drinks we had and retreated to our comfortable room. We go out and we travel a lot - this service was just plain bizarre.

The hotel itself was great. Rooms were clean and the staff was nice except for the front desk clerk who double-charged me and my friend's credit cards. When we tried to get answers, he waved his hands in our face and dismissed us and told us to talk to someone else in the morning. But other than that, not a bad place to stay.

Our stay at the Hilton Downtown Miami was nothing short of perfect. The staff were very friendly from the moment we reached there to the moment we left. I have never come across such friendly staff! We arrived there after a very long flight from Ireland and we were delighted to have such a fast check in and such friendly service. Our room was very comfortable and had a amazing view of the city and of the bay. Definitely worth the money. The breakfast buffet was quiet nice. There was one occasion in which we ordered from the menu, sadly it was a little disappointing because it was overcooked but we were taken care of almost immediately when we complained. The hotel is close to everything. All you need to do is hop on the bus or metromover which is almost outside the door! So it is impossible to complain about that! There were always taxi's at the hotel also that could bring us on a five minute trip to the beach!! Fantastic hotel, keep it up! We will be back for sure. Thanks for a great stay!! !

My wife and our 2 kids stayed at the hotel after our cruise trip and one of the good, amoung others, is how close is the hotel from the miami port....it's just like 10 minutes! When we finally got to the lobby (because it's a little bit tricky) it was full of people checking in, but everything ran just perfect thanks to the professionalism and friendly attitude of the front desk agents. We got an upgrade when checked in to a better view room, bay/city view which was gorgeous, specially at night! The kids wanted to go the pool, so went there and had some really good sandwiches and the pool was clean and not so many people at all. The executive lounge is in the 16th floor (also a great view!) and there we met Luis who was very friendly and polite, always smiling and as it was our first time in miami he kindly answer ALL of our questions. We also wanted to go out for dinner(the snacks in the lounge weren't enough for the kids)so he recommended a very good restaurant near the bay area and he even called there and made us a reservation so we didn't have to wait for the line. Everytime we ran into someone they always saluted us. I thinks the location it's not the best for young people or a group of friends because there not much to do, but for just one night when traveling for business or with family it's a great place. I would go and would stay again without any doubts.

selected_reviews.text: we are local but made a "staycation" out of my birthday celebration for a night. the romance package is worth the upgrade because it includes champagne, valet parking, chocolates and breakfast, and they even cover the bed with rose petals if/when you leave the room after check-in. if i had to nit pick i would say that a couple of lights switches and one of the phones did not work (ironic for a restored electric building) but in all honesty none of those defects affected our stay, which is probably why no one bothered to report them before; having said that a hotel of this stature should probably have better quality control so i still deducted one star from my rating. other than that the bathroom is not very private so if you want to preserve the "romance" factor you'll need to make a trip to the lobby because the ballroom level restroom is kept locked.

The Joule was a great hotel to stay at in Dallas. When we first arrived there was tea and cookies in the lobby waiting for all of the guest, with a fantastic array of decorations in the lobby. When we spoke to one of the front desk clerks they said it used to be a bank and it was to be designed along the lines of natural elements such as wind and water. When we got to our room it was very modern and high tech with all of the light switches and lamp knobs. However, we didn't reserve a handicap room but got oen anyway with two beds. The shower was GREAT, the beds were GREAT but the view was looking at airconditioners which didn't bother us because we weren't looking out that much. Also the maids probably need to consider dusting in the bathroom lights becuase they were covered in dust! We ate breakfest downstairs at Charlie Palmer which was one of the best hotel breakfest experiences I have ever had. The service was amazing and the food was amazing.

Stayed there for one night so I did not get to use any of the hotel services nor dine there. However, the staff were all very nice and helpful. They also have complimentary car service via a Cadillac Escalade which takes you and picks you up anywhere within 5 miles of the hotel. Truly a wonderful, and from my experience unique service. Being it is very contemporary, be prepared for glass shower and toilet doors. Bed was very plush and comfortable.

I read the reviews before I went so I addressed some of the service issues beforehand. My boyfriend and I stayed there for his birthday and I wanted everything to be perfect. Jessica, the front desk manager, was great. Their new GM is aware of the service issues they have had and he is working to turn it around. We were treated very well. They had a bottle of champagne,yummy chocolates and a cheese platter in the room. We stayed in one of the lofts and initially had some temperature issues but they were addressed quickly. The room was fantastic. Well decorated, sleek and modern. They have the top of the line Beautyrest mattress which was really comfortable. Two of the three bathrooms had huge walk in showers and double showerheads. The owner is an art collector so the lobby was decorated with pieces from his own personal collection. There is a sustainable energy theme in the hotel and Jessica and Brandon gave us the background story. If you go ask the front desk about it. Charlie Palmers is connected to the hotel and it is excellent. The sommelier at Charlie Palmers, Brandon was awesome. He coordinated with NOKA Chocolates for a private wine and chocolate pairing on Saturday afternoon. The pool area was packed and we had a cabana reserved for us. The pool is small but they keep it very cool and refreshing. It had a mini-Vegas poolside vibe. Their nightclub, PM, manages the pool area. We had opportunity to go to PM that night as well. We got the red carpet treatment. They had initially reserved us a table but when we got there it had been given away. They apologized profusely and comped us all our drinks. I would say that this place is worth a chance despite the reviews. The staff seems very willing to hear feedback and make it better. We had a lovely, relaxing weekend.

Stayed at this property the day before Valentines with my wife. We were impressed with how intimate and different this hotel is. It is definitely worth checking out while in Dallas. The decor is artsy and modern, great location, in a historic building. The room was beautifully appointed with a round bed, bvlagari amenities, rainfall shower, and oversized flat screen. The room was surprisingly small and the bed was terrible, i liked the idea of a round bed as it is unique but it was very awkward and felt cheap..not a luxury collection standard. We used the house car, a Cadillac Escalade which took us around, nice touch but the car wasnt as clean as it should have been and the driver didnt seem like he wanted to take us. Other than that no complaints, beautiful pool on the 10th floor and up to date fitness center with bottles of water and fruit. The Joule really is a gem and I would return but probably would opt for a different room catogory

selected_reviews.text: This is a great hotel to visit. The staff for the most part are excellent and helpful. For the most part the staff doesnt have all the attitude that the W staff does. Some of the younger front desk staff tend to be a little snooty. but for the most part, the staff is excellent. The concierge is very helpful and knows his stuff. The manager of the attached restaurantis also really helpful and provides excellent service - even though the restaurant is independently managed. The rooms are awesome except for the lack of privacy in the toilets that others have mentioned. The view from the lower floors is kinda cruddy and the street noise might get loud on the weekend. Overall, can't wait to come back.

I travel at least once a month for work, and I was fortunate enough to stay at this hotel last February and it's such a charming hotel. The staff are courteous and professional, without overdoing it. The design and decor is incredible. The have really nice turn down service, too. The hotel and guest rooms are cozy without feeling too small. I would never hesitate to return to this hotel. I hope to be back.

I live in the north DFW area, and it is my job to become very famiilar with many hotels and their services around the Metro-plex. The Joule was a refreshing experience and definitely a cut above the rest. Once I arrived, Danielle took great care to check me in and point me in the direction of my room, which I didn't leave much unless it was to have a meeting downstairs in the restaurant. Also, I must admit I took the liberty of telling alot of my friends about the beautiful pool that I had an hour to indulge in! It's not often I can say that I was treated like a celebrity. Craig respected my need for adhearance to a timely schedule during my check out and made it a seamless transaction. The decor, overall atmosphere, and excellent service in this hotel exceeds expectation. I would recommend this hotel to my existing and future out of town business clients when they visit, and I plan to make this my home away from home while conducting such visits. Thank you for renewing my faith in the hotel industry!

Stayed there for one night so I did not get to use any of the hotel services nor dine there. However, the staff were all very nice and helpful. They also have complimentary car service via a Cadillac Escalade which takes you and picks you up anywhere within 5 miles of the hotel. Truly a wonderful, and from my experience unique service. Being it is very contemporary, be prepared for glass shower and toilet doors. Bed was very plush and comfortable.

Cons: Service is terrible!! Maybe I just had a bad experience but I was throughly disappointed in this hotel. It seemed as if they had the "summer staff" on duty. The valet just stood right next to me while I struggled with my luggage. He did not offer to help in any way. Once I was at the desk, I still was not offered any help with getting all my luggage to my room. That evening, I placed my room service order on my door well before the requested time of midnight. I only ordered a pot of coffee for 7am. After waiting 45 minutes, I finally opened my door and realized they didn't even pick up the card. It was still hanging on the door handle. After calling down to the desk, they did not even give a simple apology. Maybe I'm just spoiled, but I travel frequently and I have never recieved such poor service from an "upscale" hotel. Pros: The rooms were very clean and nice. I did have breakfast at the restaurant and the food was great. The service I recieved at the restaurant was also wonderful. They were prompt, polite, and very accomodating.

selected_reviews.text: i was happily surprised at the paramount hotel. first off, the location is stellar. easy 8 block walk to pike place market. the lobby is sort of lackluster but the rooms were tasfully updated and very clean. we asked and were granted an upgrade to a corner king executive which was pretty spacious. the beds were comfy and nice bathroom ammentities. only thing i did notice was in the hallways, as soon as you exited the elevator there was an odd smell but once you got inside your room it was gone. i would definitely stay here again.

The hotel is in downtown Seattle right in the middle of it all. The Paramount theatre was across the street and there's shopping on every corner. Tiffany's was down the block. Pikes Market was 4 blocks away. The staff was very friendly and we're very accommodating. Tom in the lobby was very helpful with his suggestions on which tours to take to where to eat. The room was very clean. We asked for more towels and they arrived within minutes. There is an empty fridge for your use in the room, that was great. The first two days the person cleaning the room was excellent, the weekend shift was okay it was cleaned well but forgot to replace a robe, soap and the extra towels. The problems were rectified immediately. Would stay there again.

The hotel was well designed and tastefully decorated. The room was large with a desk area, comfortable chairs and a very comfortable bed. The bathroom was roomy and supplied with great amenities. The hotel is in the downtown area and we were able to take the light rail from the airport, which was very helpful. It is within easy walking distance of shopping, great restaurants and Pike's Place. It is perfect for a couples get-away or a business trip. There is a good restaurant connected to the hotel. The personnel were very helpful and pleasant.

We've always enjoyed our stay at the Paramount Hotel in Portland, OR. So when family members were visiting us last month, we thought we'd spend a weekend with them at the Paramount in Seattle. The location was excellent (near downtown shopping as other reviewers have mentioned). Staff was very courteous and helpful. Compared to the Portland location, the Seattle Paramount needs some sprucing up. The elevator was marked and scuffed. The hallway to our room smelled of cleaning or toiletry products (we couldn't tell which). There appeared to be some water damage in our bathroom. However, our room was clean and quiet. It was a convenient location, but not a luxurious accomodation.

I did not enjoy my stay here. If you are on a budget and the other hotels are too pricy - Fairmont, etc - then this will work for you. But I thought the staff were unprofessional and I was uncomfortable with the men at the desk. I was put in a room that just didn't have the feeling be being fresh and clean. It was dark, dirty, and noisy from the construction right outside my window. The only food available is from a Chinese restaurant that is in the hotel. I didn't try it, but it doesn't look appetizing. Based on my overall experience I could not recommend this hotel.

selected_reviews.text: I was booked into this hotel for business. The staff is friendly and very helpful. The hotel was recently renovated and is really nice. The rooms were clean and I forgot an item and was able to get it back from the front desk staff. DragonFish, the restaurant downstairs was good too. I highly recommend it if staying downtown in Seattle.

The hotel was well designed and tastefully decorated. The room was large with a desk area, comfortable chairs and a very comfortable bed. The bathroom was roomy and supplied with great amenities. The hotel is in the downtown area and we were able to take the light rail from the airport, which was very helpful. It is within easy walking distance of shopping, great restaurants and Pike's Place. It is perfect for a couples get-away or a business trip. There is a good restaurant connected to the hotel. The personnel were very helpful and pleasant.

Amazing motel, amazing staff. Loved the pillowtop beds, beautiful rooms, very quiet. Big screen TV, refrigerator, coffee pot, all added to comfort. Squeaky clean room and nice size. We enjoyed dining at the Dragonfish restaurant for great food and reasonable pricing. Felt right at home and appreciated secure valet parking. Assistance is all around w/ staff waiting to help on all levels. Very close to all downtown shopping and exploring. It was a wonderful hotel, but not intimidating or snobbish. Generally, when we stay at a downtown Seattle hotel, we are happy to be getting back to our own homes and beds, but with Paramount, we were sorry we didn't have a few more days. It was that comfortable and amazing. Will definitely be booking with Paramount again soon.

The hotel since I last stayed had gone through a nice renovation. But the service I got from the staff at different times of the day was like day and night. During the morning Tom is more than willing to the extra mile to make sure you ready for your travels around the city, Jerry who works at the front desk also very helpful, nice and courteous. I will admit I made alot of requests and each time he was more than obliged to make sure it was taken care of. Lolita was great as well. Now on to the bad, the other staff. The man who was working at the front desk looked very gruff and mean, when I would ask something he made me feel like I was putting him out. He also looked very unprofessional as he was unshaven and failed to smile during my time there. The other fellow named Rich was very aloof , didnt know anything and confusing. Restaurant staff was also very poor

This hotel is probably one of the best in terms of location for shopping and restaurant etc. but the staff are a bit clueless. Every time I called down to the Front Desk with questions it felt like I was putting them out. Their tone of voice was no better than a 13 year old with a bad attitude! Not to mention when I checked in they yelled my room number out to me, not a good idea as a female travelling alone... The back breaker was when I called the concierge asking what time the mariners game started that day as I had tickets, he told me 7pm. When I got there at 7pm the game had been on for one hour as it started at 6:05!! Pretty basic information for a concierge to screw up on! When I had got back to my room the first day I was there housekeeping had still not been to my room, I had left at 9am and it was then 3:30. I called down to the front desk to find out what time housekeeping would be coming by as I wanted to have a nap before I went to the game. Their answer was they can come now or not at all as they leave at 5pm, how that was my problem I am not sure as they had all day to clean it... The restaurant was great, the service alright... The food was awesome and the prices are pretty good. Over all I would probably only stay here again based on location alone, it would have to be a good deal as well or I would stay at the Vintage Park or Pacific Plaza hotel.

selected_reviews.text: I just want to add my comments here. I was just on a business trip and because of circumstances had to stay at the Primrose for one night before I came back to the States. It was gay pride week so very few rooms were available and I had to take a smoking room here at this God-awful place. I've stayed in many places around the world but this was the worst. You felt as if you needed a shower just being in the hotel. It is very worn and in a terrible area of town. Nothing in the room felt clean and I agree with one reviewer that the bed "crunched". I could not believe what they charged for a room at this hell-hole, and it is funny just around the corner from the building is a "back-packer's hostel which I thought would have been much better than this dump. Heed this warning stay away from this crappy place, you'll be glad you did.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: My friends and I decided to stay at this hotel for two nights because the price was so good. The hotel was dirty. The shower was disgusting and there were marks all over the walls and carpet. The hallways were also very dim and can be scary at night. The elevators took forever! Be prepared to wait at least five minutes, and the doors sensors do not work, which was very annoying. The staff treatment was alright. They weren't that friendly. I had called down to front desk to ask for some extra towels and they were giving me a hard time. We had also asked the concierge for directions to certain areas in Toronto and he wasn't helpful. I guess this hotel would be ok for people who are looking to party. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for a nice weekend getaway or a family looking for a vacation. Spend the extra money and stay somewhere clean with friendly service.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: This was my second stay at the Best Western Primrose in the past year and I would have no hestitation in staying again. I booked a smoking room with a king-size bed. It was a business class room, which I didn't really need, but I had anticipated having someone else come along on this trip. The room also included a sofa bed. The room was spacious and clean with an extremely comfortable bed. Is the hotel showing signs of wear? Sure, it's not a new hotel. If I looked closely I could see where the wallpaper had been patched in a spot near the bed's headboard. It wasn't obvious and I only noticed it because I was accessing a wall plug behind the bedside table. The carpet could use replacing for staining, but it wasn't dirty, just old. The lobby was clean, as was the elevator. Checking in and out was very quick. The staff were friendly and efficient. The location is great. Close enough to walk to the Eaton Centre. Close to good restaurants. The subway station is only a few blocks away and the street car passes right in front of the hotel.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: What is wrong with people? This is a good hotel we had no problems with our stay or room. The room was clean there were no stains anywhere, nice bed and dÃ©cor was good. People stay in hotels and expect them to be newly decorated for them rooms have to be used and accommodating. We use many hotels and in our stays, at Best Westerns all over the world have not had a bad one in the chain. Reception staff were polite and respected us, if you give staff respect we always find they give respect back, if you treat staff without respect what do you expect in return? Even housekeeping spoke to us in a morning and passed the time of day. The porterage was efficient and the bell boys were polite. We stayed with a tour on 9/10 September and would have no hesitation at staying or recommending this hotel again. My partner has worked in hotels for over 30 years and a lot of it in management and he would know a bad one as soon as he walked in. We normally take pictures of the rooms we stay in but unforunately did not on this occassion, if had they would have been put on here good or bad.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: This was certainly not the greatest hotel I have ever stayed in. I picked it because it was three stars, had internet access, and was stumbling distance from the concert two of us were attending. I booked a single room with two beds for the four of us and it was acceptable. Well, with the exception of the bathroom. It was small and not very clean. The staff were rude and quite useless, they just seemed annoyed and unwilling to help no matter how polite we were. Which made it easy to stumble through the lobby drunk and singing at 1:00 a.m. There was a 'restaurant' that never did open the three days, two nights we stayed and no room service. None of the 'perks' of the hotel were available-pool, steam room, gym, and the TV was old and hardly worked. The room we payed for with internet access, didn't have internet access. They at least lent us an external wifi card but it still didn't work. And they never did give us any form of refund for that either. There were 'ladies of the night' out front of the hotel, but they were harmless and didn't hassle us at all. I had a great time, as did my other friend. But that was due to the amount of rum we consumed and an amazing concert. I don't feel our two friends enjoyed the stay as much as we did. I would not stay there again.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: My experience at this hotel was the worst I've ever experience within the service industry. It is obvious that Customer Service is not a priority for this hotel. All they want is money. The front desk is rude and inexperienced. Being from out of town, we drove to Toronto to spend a nice week-end. The first impression we got from the Primrose Best Western was rudeness. Before checking in, they rudely told us that the parking space we had requested had been given to someone else and that we were to go down the street to public parking lot. THEY GAVE US WRONG DIRECTIONS. When we tried to call them asking for clarification as they had given us wrong directions, the women on the phone began yelling at us, denying that they gave us wrong directions and continuously transferred our call. It took 10 minutes before another hotel representative came on to give us proper directions. We were lost in a city we HAD never been in for 10 mintues during the night. Then came the room. We specficially asked for a king size bed with no kitchenette. When we got to our room, we got 2 separate beds and a kitchentte. What made it worse was we asked for a non-smoking floor and throughout the whole week-end all we could smell was cigarette smoke. They NEVER once apologized for their mix-ups and behaviours. I cannot begin to explain how awful this hotel is. It may be cheaper than other hotels, but the abuse you experience is not worth it. In my entire life, I have never been treated in such a rude, disrespecting manner. I would not reccomend this place to even my worst ennemies.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: Our church group recently stayed at the Primrose Hotel. We had chosen this hotel as it was downtown and they were able to give us a discounted group rate as we had 17 rooms in total. Everything went very smoothly. All the guests were checked- in in advance so no one had to line up at the front desk. The doorman assisted everyone with their luggage and picked it up when we left and brought it to the bus. The group in general was pleased with the rooms. We had a mixture of rooms with 1 bed and some with 2 beds. The service was great and we had a breakfast arranged in a private dining room which everyone enjoyed. I was pleased with the service I received from the staff both when arranging the tour and during the stay. We plan to make this an annual trip and will check back first with the Primrose before looking elsewhere for rooms.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Primrose Hotel Toronto Downtown
selected_reviews.text: Hotel staff were very friendly and accomadating. Vicky at the front desk was very nice and made us feel welcome. The hotel is situated in a good area and walking distance to Eaton Centre and many other attractions. We were there for a Chicago concert at Massey Hall and it was about a ten minute walk. We also experienced the subway and found it was very easy to get around. Over all our hotel was clean and we had a newly renovated room. I would stay here again!

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: We chose this hotel for its location, which is excellent, as you can walk everywhere from there. It's also right next door to Eaton Center shopping area, where you can catch the subway and all the tour busses. We stayed in a one bedroom suite with a connecting dbl / dbl (5 of us). While the beds were comfy and we had plenty of room, the guest rooms are in need of a renovation. Had all standard amenities including coffee maker and fridge and robes . The rooms were clean, but when you looked closely, you would feel it needed a deep clean.. Ie around baseboards, walls and ceiling in bath, etc. service was excellent at front desk and concierge! Only had a drink in the bar, which was average hotel lobby bar. Didn't eat there. My biggest negative would be the super thin, over starched towels.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: We were attending a conference in the hotel so we basically had no choice when it came to picking a hotel in Toronto. Check-in : Everything went accordingly to plan. We were given our king size room which we had booked months earlier. Room : The room was just another hotel room , nothing flash but it was comfortable. The room consisted of a king size bed , small settee , coffee table and working desk with internet connection. The bathroom was on the small size with shower over the bath. Adequate toiletries were supplied. I actually like the aromatherapy orange ginger body lotion and managed to take a bottle home with me. Breakfast : A good selection with a chef cooking omelettes. Bar : We used the bar area frequently for pre dinner drinks and also returning home in the evenings. The staff were very efficient and friendly. Overall : The Marriott Hotel served a purpose and we had a comfortable stay. Our rate due to the conference was very reasonable so no complaints. The Eaton Shopping centre can be easily reached from the hotel. We also experienced a false fire alarm which was disconcerting as it took quite some time for us to get through to the receptionist to see whether we should proceed down the fire stairs or stay put..

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: My boyfriend is partial to the Marriott chain, so when we booked to stay here we came with high expectations. We werenâ€™t disappointed. The king bed was super comfortable â€“ you literally just sink right in, it feels so delicious just lying down. I can see why they advertise and sell their own bedding. The room we had was a decent size and had a nice view. The location canâ€™t be beat, youâ€™re right in the heart of the city, right next to the Eaton Centre and steps away from the hive of Dundas Square. The valets recommended cheap indoor parking in the office building next door. We usually check out the amenities of every hotel we stay at but on this stay we had a long full day and just had time to settle in for a good nightâ€™s rest. We had no issue with noise, and we slept really well.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: Stayed at the Marriott for three nights for a conference. The room was typically Marriott - very nice, great view of the Church and gardens in between the Eaton Centre. The staff were wonderful! Bonus, no need to go out with a coat since the Marriott has indoor access to the Eaton Center...Shoppers Heaven for sure!!! Also had a problem with the shower - very hot...but not an issue. Had a Bloody Ceasar at the Hotel Bar...ouch..10$ for a small glass. Decided to go shopping instead...hihi! !

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: I don't agree with the majority of the rave reviews for this hotel. It's best asset is the central Toronto location and beautiful public areas. However, the rooms are very average (no safe, mini-bar for example). During my stay, the first room I was given had a locked adjoining door. The room next to mine was obviously a large suite occupied by several people. Because of the adjoining door and no soundproofing between these rooms, I could hear their group conversations as if they were sitting next to me. Finally I called at midnight to insist on another room which they gave me. However, the next day after walking around in this room for an hour in clean white socks...I noticed that the bottom of these socks were filthy with dirt, grime. Obviously this hotel very rarely shampoos the carpets. My basic perception was that the rooms had a dated, unclean vibe. I will not stay there again.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: We had stayed in this hotel half-a-dozen times in the past and had been very impressed with it. The service has always been excellent. We often used to go on massive shopping trips and had to transport many large boxes to and from our rooms. The bell staff (usually women) would handle this for us cheerfully. I would often try to tip them, sometimes $20, but they always refused, stating that it was against hotel policy and that it was "part of the service". This happened all the time, and still did on this last trip. The location is also perfect for us: next to the Eaton Centre and walking distance to Chinatown and Queen Street. The rooms are large and the food in the dining room is decent enough. Now maybe our expectations of hotels have risen in recent years, or maybe we were just given a uniquely bad room for the first time, but our room was noisy! It was like there was no sound-proofing whatsoever. We could hear people walking and talking in the hallway and talking in the next room. This really annoys me, enough that I will not stay there again in spite of the excellent service.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: Cannot complain about hotel. Staff was confused as to the concierge lounge, but that was it. Beware of tight turns in for parking garage under facility. You may have a difficult fit. Modern facility, quiet. Highly recommend. Best to call property directly for best rates. Marriott website or other sites may not have best rates.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff, good food - pity the room wiater couldn't go further than the threshold !!!! Oh and if you are a husband leave your wallet at home as the hotel is connected to the Eaton Centre; shopping mecca for wives !!!!! !

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: I spent the better part of a week at this property. The room was comfortable and well-equipped...except for a small fridge that I was unable to obtain during my stay. The highlight for me was th staff. From the front desk to housekeeping to the restaurant/bar service, everyone was polite and very helpful. It turned out to be a very good choice for me.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: Toronto Marriott Downtown Eaton Centre Hotel
selected_reviews.text: We have stayed at this Marriott many times but this was our first time back since the renovation and it did not disapoint. Rooms were spotless, and big enough. The staff was great right from check-in with a "welcome back" from every employee starting with the valet. Special thanks to Danny for being so nice with the kids he was awesome! One of the best features of this hotel is its proximity to the Eaton Centre as it is connected with a walkway so you can leave your coats in your room and shop all day. It is also right beside Nathan Phillips Square, which has a skating rink all winter. The buffett breakfast which was included with our rate was good every morning and better than most hotels. The pool is small but sufficent. We can't wait to come back!

query: hotel room cleanliness and bathroom hygiene

selected_reviews.text: This is my second visit to Granville Island Hotel in eight years and both times have been exceptional; last time I didn’t know about tripadvisor though! I’ve been here for nine days and I couldn’t be happier. I looked at a few different rooms and they vary in size and view. They’re currently renovating all the bathrooms and the new look is beautiful; even nicer than the Hyatt Regency where I stayed a few days prior to this hotel. All the rooms have been remodeled with nice big screen TVs, very comfortable beds and nice décor. Even the bathrooms in the rooms where the bathrooms have not yet been remodeled are still very nice. I recommend room 326… vaulted ceiling with cedar beams, king bed, wet bar and a fantastic water view… at a standard room price. The service is fantastic… in nine days I’ve only encountered nice, friendly, helpful, courteous, attentive and caring employees. A special shout-out to Christine, AJ, Oleg Adam and Kim for their help. They go above and beyond and seem to really enjoy making sure the guests are happy. The housekeeping service is excellent; the room was spotless every day. At the hotel’s restaurant where I ate often, the service was attentive and friendly; they even went out of their way tonight to make a strawberry compote for the cheesecake because I didn’t want the cherry compote! They asked me if I wouldn’t mind waiting as they offered to make it from scratch… highly worth the wait. I also recommend the huevos rancheros for breakfast. The food is excellent and the view is amazing. Granville Island is an oasis inside a city. If you’re looking for an active nightlife then this isn’t the right fit. If you’re looking for a walk-able and relaxing spot then this couldn’t be better! I travel often, I stay in many nice hotels and I really can’t find any suggestions for improvement here. In Vancouver, I’ll only stay here from now on.

This is a great hotel and obviously a favorite with discerning locals having events...they weren't really an obstruction to our having a great time, but did become something of a joke as both the hotel and adjoining park/marina/galleries are dripping with wedding parties. We had a great room at the end of the hall with a king size bed, and a connecting door to a smaller room with two doubles. The end room is great because even though it's small, 2 walls are window-sliders to balconies overlooking ritzy boats and water traffic. Restaurant was great. Bathrooms are super-luxorious. Beds are lush. We travelled with 4 kids and still had a terrific, romantic weekend!

I love the location of this hotel! Its perfect to be near the water and located in one of the greatest areas in Vancouver. I checked in no problem and they gave us a room they was sort of facing the water. Meaning you had to go out on to the balcony and look to your right to see water. The room also had a weird smell. I checked their website and discovered they allow pets, which explains the tile room in that room. I'm assuming the previous occupant was a negligent pet owner and allowed their pet to do their business everywhere in the room. We asked for another room right away and managed to get something that was equivalent to the one we had. I'm guessing that was fortunate since it was Easter and a conference was coming in a few days. The good stuff: the rooms are clean and tidy. The restaurant on the ground floor is excellent. The room service was great! Didn't try out the pool. Most of the staff was friendly. It was convienient to grab breakfast from the Granville Market and the restaurants in Granville are excellent. We went to the Pacific Culinary Institute and that was amazing!

The room was so tiny we could hardly fit in it. No carpet on the floor, hardly any outlets and the bathroom was too small. We requested a larger room, since we were a group of three, previously booked and wanting an adequate room. We were told none were available. The room was small and dark and old. In no way was this a three star hotel. We left that night for a better place.

I really loved this hotel. The location is cool in that you're in the only hotel on the Island, everyone knows where to find it, and it's central in the city. The hotel itself is reasonably priced, has very open meeting rooms with doors directly outside. The rooms are VERY clean (very), and the bathrooms are quite luxurious. The one drawback is that it's not that well insulated, sound-wise. I could hear the seagulls in the morning, and if there's a party in the hotel, you might want to bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper.

We stayed there for a wedding last weekend and the location was handy. Unfortunately they just don't have the level of service that would make them a great hotel. The staff just seemed disinterested, especially at the bar and the front desk. And what kind of hotel charges for local calls?! Oh, and the sauna was broken.

We are a 40-something couple travelling with 3 small children. Since we'd heard that the rooms can vary in size and view, we requested (at booking) a larger room and a nice view, both of which were accommodated by the hotel. The highlight was the restaurant, which had the best food on the island and quite possibly in all of Vancouver's westside. Unbelievable. My husband tried a different beer each night that was micro-brewed at the hotel. He was very impressed and requested a tour of the brewery, which the brew-master provided for him. The rooms were very clean and comfortable. The walls were thick and the hotel had a quiet but friendly feel to it. Our girls loved the decent-sized hot tube with the windowed ceiling that allowed us to watch the starts at night. The location was ideal and the staff were superb. What would have made this hotel a 5-star for us would have been if the concierge had been more knowledgeable, particularly with transit options for exploring attractions.

This is a wonderful hotel with really nice staff and is a beautiful place to go for a drink or to stay. We arrived after a 9 hour flight from London on our honeymoon and thanks to our bestman the hotel knew about this and upgraded us.Then later in the evening the booking for the penthouse was cancelled, and guy at the desk asked if we would like to move. This was more than considerate and made for a wonderful first night. Apart from the special treatment that we recieved we found all the people who worked there to be really nice and interested in having a conversation. This is a very well set up hotel. The views of South Downtown are amazing (see pics).

We arrived and right away the staff were helpful. The one woman at the desk was dealing with an elderly WomAn that was taking a very long time talking. The woman at the desk saw I was waiting and made sure she got another person to come out and help me. I requested a room with a view and a rain shower and a king bed and I recieved all my requests, I was very pleased. The room was beautiful, the staff were very pleasant and the food from the restiarant Downstairs was delicious. They had very fast room service as well. Highly enjoyed our stay and the next time we have the money to go out for a nice weekend again, we will definitely be going back here :)

query: hotel room cleanliness and bathroom hygiene

selected_reviews.text: What a wonderful overnight stay as we prepared to go to Sick Kids the next day. From the valet staff to the front desk, to the cleaning staff, everyone was curteous and very friendly. Whomever has trained the satff at this hotel really did their homework on the importance of smiling and friendly service. My room was sizeable, very clean, in fact the entire hotel has an almost brand new feel to it. The bathroom has no bathtub (who uses that in hotels anyway?) and instead had a very large glassed in shower area. Fridge and microwave in the room were very convenient. the Pool, while not large, was comfortable and clean, and the workout facilities were excellent. Staff at the complimentary breakfast were also superb,. All in all, a great overnight, and I would not hesitate to stay there again.

Spent a long weekend here in November and would return. The rooms are in excellent condition, housekeeping is very good, and the location is very handy to everything downtown. I would avoid the restaurant in the hotel as the service is slow and inconsistent. There are literally hundreds of other options nearby. I suggest you ask for a room on a high floor as there is a noisy club South of the hotel on the ground floor.

My friends and I always book the Hilton when we have a big night out downtown for its convenience and great rooms. It's a one to ten minute walk from all the clubs in that area, in fact it's right NEXT to one. Despite this (and some of the other reviews), I found that the hotel is quiet and I was never disturbed by what is going outside. We've stayed here at least 5 times, the last being NYE. That was a bit of a pain, but understandable, because it was getting extremely rowdy and it was clear people were bringing in about 10 people into one room. This night was a bit of a mess; we would walk out to the hallway and smell weed, hear loud music blasting, etc. Every other time we had no problems, however there are only 2 elevators and they DO take a while, especially that night. Excellent rooms. We usually get the 2 queen beds, very spacious, comfortable, clean. Washroom is big too, lots of counter space (which is handy when you have 4 girls doing their hair and makeup). A HUGE plus is that there's a microwave and mini-fridge in every room! Staff is also very friendly and accommodating. If you want to check in early (it's usually 3pm), call in advance and many times they have some rooms that are ready, and they'll let you in with no extra charge. This has happened for us several times. If we call for extra towels/sheets/cups, it's all sent up very quickly by housekeeping staff. Love this hotel, great location ... if you're a group of young people looking for nightlife and shopping (Queen West is right there with a bunch of stores, Chinatown and Kensington is walking distance), definitely give this hotel a shot!

We live in Toronto, so don't stay in Toronto hotels very often. However, we had a Jaunt coupon (which also included $50 for hotel expenses) so decided to make an event of it. We were attending a theatre just a 7 minute walk from hotel. The front desk staff were friendly and efficient. The room was large and very clean. The shower was one of the best we have ever had at any hotel *anywhere*. The food at dinner was very good and the breakfast that was included with the room package was excellent. We will stay here again and would recommend this hotel without hesitation.

Great hotel! Excellent location! We could see the CN tower from our room. Bathroom very clean. However the carpet in the room had 2 stains. Since we never walk bare feet on the carpet and the rest was clean, I assumed it had been cleaned but it didn't come off. We were allowed to check in a couple of hours earlier which helped us a lot (to drop off the luggage). Wireless internet was complimentary in the room which is great. There was a little noise in the adjacent rooms, walls are paper-thin as in most hotels. Recommended!

query: hotel staff service friendliness and responsiveness

selected_reviews.text: I spent a night here using a wagjag voucher (amazing deal), the hotel was great, nice room, very friendly staff.. loved the free cookies in the lobby! The only issue was that it was VERY NOISY at night having multiple clubs right outside the front doors. We were on the 15th floor and it still carried up and made it hard to sleep. If you are a light sleeper bring ear plugs.. the hotel should just warn people ahead of time or have ear plugs in the rooms as a courtesy. Everything about this hotel was great it's too bad something so negative like this is pretty much out of their control. Restaurant was really good too with great service! I would recommend this hotel but wouldnt stay there again on a night the clubs are open.

The hotel delivers on everything it promises. I used the room for sleeping and to prepare for some meetings. Quiet, comfortable and utilitarian. I used to stay at the full service Hilton on Rishmond, but I prefer the low key ambience of this Hilton brand. The bed and the linens were excellent. I kno they have some sort of sleep selection gizmo on the bed, but I fell in love with the mattress all the same. I wasn't staying there for a vacation, although it makes a nice place to do that if you are visiting Toronto, but was there for a good night's sleep for business. I got that rest I needed and just for that, the hotel gets my repeat business. The dining option was reasonable and the food (dinner & breakfast) was ok. Actually, dinner was of better quality than I was expecting since this wasn't a full service Hilton. yet the restaurant had the same high quality as the big box Hilton. The prices were comparative to the restaurants in the neighborhood with the difference that service was much better and of course there was the convenience. There was even a decent wine selction and a waiter that offered reliable advice. Someone invested in training the staff and it showed. The hotel also had professional trained desk personnel. I was checking in and waiting while one of the people at the desk was providing directions to a guest. Sometimes desk people can have an attitude, but not this woman. A sincere smile and a really good attitude. That's how a hotel gets repeat business and builds brand loyalty. I am usually tough in my reviews, but honestly, I can't find one fault with this place. I got what I paid for and a bit more at that. Maybe some hotels have a lower rate, but if you are looking for consistency, and quality at a competitive room rate in the downtown core, you really cannot go wrong with this place.

Fridge and microwave in the room were very convenient. the Pool, while not large, was comfortable and clean, and the workout facilities were excellent. Staff at the complimentary breakfast were also superb,. All in all, a great overnight, and I would not hesitate to stay there again.

Spent a long weekend here in November and would return. The rooms are in excellent condition, housekeeping is very good, and the location is very handy to everything downtown. I would avoid the restaurant in the hotel as the service is slow and inconsistent. There are literally hundreds of other options nearby. I suggest you ask for a room on a high floor as there is a noisy club South of the hotel on the ground floor.

My friends and I always book the Hilton when we have a big night out downtown for its convenience and great rooms. It's a one to ten minute walk from all the clubs in that area, in fact it's right NEXT to one. Despite this (and some of the other reviews), I found that the hotel is quiet and I was never disturbed by what is going outside. We've stayed here at least 5 times, the last being NYE. That was a bit of a pain, but understandable, because it was getting extremely rowdy and it was clear people were bringing in about 10 people into one room. This night was a bit of a mess; we would walk out to the hallway and smell weed, hear loud music blasting, etc. Every other time we had no problems, however there are only 2 elevators and they DO take a while, especially that night. Excellent rooms. We usually get the 2 queen beds, very spacious, comfortable, clean. Washroom is big too, lots of counter space (which is handy when you have 4 girls doing their hair and makeup). A HUGE plus is that there's a microwave and mini-fridge in every room! Staff is also very friendly and accommodating. If you want to check in early (it's usually 3pm), call in advance and many times they have some rooms that are ready, and they'll let you in with no extra charge. This has happened for us several times. If we call for extra towels/sheets/cups, it's all sent up very quickly by housekeeping staff. Love this hotel, great location ... if you're a group of young people looking for nightlife and shopping (Queen West is right there with a bunch of stores, Chinatown and Kensington is walking distance), definitely give this hotel a shot!

query: hotel room cleanliness and bathroom hygiene

selected_reviews.text: We have just got back from staying at this hotel for 2 weeks. It was very clean and our room was ok. the staff were very freindly and the only bad report that we have is with the shuttle busses. We didn't want to drive so we relied on these and they took ages and were in a very bed condition. however this is not the hotels fault but Disney as they put on the transport. All in all a great budget place to stay

I stayed for a couple of nights in October 2011 prior to attending a conference at one of the Disney resorts. Having done a lot of budget US motel travel in the past, this motel is little different from any of the other sub $50-a-night places that you can stay in across the USA. My room was spacious and clean(ish), with TV, fridge, microwave and a/c. However, it was all pretty lived-in and tired in truth (and yes, as others have mentioned, the room did smell damp). The bathroom was clean but again old - towels and other laundry were acceptable. There is a light breakfast served every morning - cornflakes, toast and coffee - which is again ok but nothing special. Staff are helpful and generally friendly. People have mentioned bugs and other critters in previous reviews - I didn't get any bedbug bites, but I did have to evict a cockroach that I found crawling across a wall on the second night. So, on balance, yes, it's cheap if you're on a big budget but, when you balance it all up, unless you're ok with roughing it a bit, you might want to consider paying a few mpore dollars and going for something a little more up-market.

The hotel stay cost about $100.00 to stay 4 nights through a promotion for free nights so I was impressed with the price! There was a very distinctive odor in the room, not sure if it was moldy or cleaning products or a mixture of both. In fact when I got back home even my clean clothes still had that smell on them! My papers and clothes also had a damp feeling to them. Bed was clean but there were small ants on the sink by the bathroom. We ended up changing rooms to a upper floor with a larger bed (we originally had 2 doubles). No ants, but still that same odor. Our tub had a cover over it and I was afraid to lift it up to see what was under it. Breakfast was disappointing but we usually just ate toast to get us going.

We have just returned from a weeks holiday staying at the Quality Inn. We were worried after reading the reviews. When we arrived I immediately went to look at the rooms,the rooms were clean and we had clean sheets and towels daily. As we had two double rooms for four of us there was plenty of room. My children (18, 15) were in the room next door and as there was a door inbetween the rooms we unlocked this and made it much easier to go to each others room. The air con. was superb and not noisy. We had breakfast every morning and although basic it was ok. We booked our Universal Studio tickets here and got a very good deal. The location couldn't be better and there are lots of restaurants around the hotel. It was very quiet at night and we all slept peacefully on the comfortable beds. We got a great last minute deal with First Choice and to be honest we were expecting the worst but we were happy with everything. We normally go on 5 star cruises and we are all fussy and expect our moneys worth. Well we got a 2plus hotel and were satisfied. We left early to get to the parks and arrived back late after shopping at the outlets, so it did us for a week. We never used the pool as there were only a few sun parasols and it was just too hot to be in the full sun. Everyone at the hotel was pleasant and helpful. All in all its a basic clean hotel in a good location to all parks and restaurants. We would have struggled without the hire car so I would advise you to get one! We would stay here again, if you want more luxury it is not for you, if you want a clean safe place and conveniently located for parks then its perfect! The money we saved bought us lots of super things from the Malls and Outlets. If you do go here dont forget the free newspaper in the reception every morning.

This was our second stay here, we were here previously in the summer of 2006 (it was Quality Inn Maingate West back then). We booked our stay based on our previous experience. Our stay this time was pretty good again. The room was good, but on checking in it was obvious that someone had used the room after it was cleaned - some cookiecrumbs and an empty sodabottle were left behind. Not a big issue, but that shouldn't happen. We complained to the manager and were promptly offered another room. Since it was late at night and the other room was in a different part of the hotel we chose to stay. Apart from this initial hickup our stay was uneventful, the staff was friendly and helpful. The breakfast was decent - not as good as I've had at other hotels, but it was free so one shouldn't complain :) The location is awesome, about 15 minutes to Disney and almost within walking distance from some nice restaurants. There's a Walmart and a Target store about 20 minutes West from the hotel, some shopping arease (groceries, pharmacy etc) are closer by. On site there's a (small) pool, washing and drying facilities ($2 each, I believe), very cool. The one thing I was a bit 'meh' about; you have to pay for ice. Not much, but you have to bring a quarter to fill your ice-bucket, annoying if you don't know this and have to walk back to your room to find change. Other than the small annoyance with the room on checking in and the icemachine, I can wholeheartedly recommend this hotel. The price is right, and the location is super!

query: hotel staff service friendliness and responsiveness

selected_reviews.text: Spent a week at this hotel while we visited the Orlando area and parks. I was a bit concerned given some of the comments from other reviewers, however given how much it was costing us (£20 a night) I was pleasantly surprised. There was plently of parking and the first room they put us in was clean and tidy, however a bit dark. So we asked to get moved and this was not a problem. Again the room was clean, even if the furnishings and fittings were a bit worn and the towels a bit thin, but again for the price we paid...... The breakfast was only coffee, OJ, cereal and toast, however this was adequate for us and our children. If we wanted more we would go to the Ponderosa just down the road. We were out of the room by 8am and not normally back until nightime, and this hotel was ideal for this kind of vacation. A free bus was provided to the parks but we just used our car. The hotel is situated aound 10 mins from disney world. Also the guys at the front desk were helpful, and the park tickets and advice given were of great help (for my wallet as well). All in all, this is the perfect hotel if you are intending to visit the parks every day and just have somewhere to rest your head at night. Don't expect anything luxurious, but it is good value for money.

We have just got back from staying at this hotel for 2 weeks. It was very clean and our room was ok. the staff were very freindly and the only bad report that we have is with the shuttle busses. We didn't want to drive so we relied on these and they took ages and were in a very bed condition. however this is not the hotels fault but Disney as they put on the transport. All in all a great budget place to stay

We are a family of 5. I was quite nervous before our arrival at this hotel after reading some of these reviews. This hotel was a great value for our 2 week stay. The location was great. 5 minutes from Animal Kingdom gate using back road called Sherberth. Huge clean heated pool. We had a fridge and microwave which made the stay all the better. Never ate breakfast at the hotel because it was somewhat underwhelming so had breakfast in our room and we would drive to McDonalds to get our morning coffee. On-site laundry great feature for our stay. We were on the 3rd floor backside of hotel therefore no noise from above and very little walking by or from road. The staff were always friendly and helpful. Always had clean towels and linens. We would leave a tip for housekeeping because hey... someone else is cleaning up after my family so for this I am quite grateful! Walking distance to grocery, pharmacy, and restaurants. Very close to Super Target, Olive Garden, Publix you name it! Now for the negatives again keeping in mind we were able secure a great price for our stay so negatives are very few in our minds Wi-fi does not go much further than the lobby we already knew this from prior reviews and it really didn't matter. The rooms and hotel are a bit tired and in need of a reno. Keeping in mind that we did not travel to Florida for a hotel room. We simply needed a safe, clean place (our room was somewhat clean we helped it out a bit) to drop our stuff and lay our heads at night for 2 weeks. Everything we requested we were able to have. I did phone a couple of days prior to our arrival to secure the items that I had requested via our internet reservation. At that time I also requested a room on the third floor due to previous reviews on here. We would definitely stay here again for the money that we spent. Everything worked out really well for us.

3 times to this 2 star hotel,it meet my needs but metro shuttle service should be terminated,they were 1.5 hours late and desk could not get a hold of them.breakfast was not much but ok for on the run.my room next to office so had good internet.only paid about 30.00 per night so very low cost.pool was clean on this trip.close to shops and restraunts.so i will stay again .

An excellent budget motel, better than many in this area. Room was clean and beds comfortable. Beware the hotel's own website which says "All guestrooms are handsomely and newly furnished with Refrigerator, microwave....". The fridge and microwave are not available in 'standard' rooms. Breakfast room is a little small for the number of guests, and resulted in a scrum every morning, but the breakfast itself is adequate to start the day. Reception staff mostly very pleasant and helpful except for one older woman who was abrupt and unhelpful. Would certainly stay there again.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: The Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center
selected_reviews.text: This was our 3rd stay at the Stone Castle Hotel. It is a good value for the money. Nothing fancy, just a good clean place to stay. It has 2 swimming pools, which was good because if one was really full, the other one usually wasn't. Our room was clean. The bathroom was squeeky clean. The lighting in the main part was a little on the dark side, but we weren't in our room very much, so this wasn't an issue. It did make it hard to read of an evening though. Breakfast was good and the breakfast room was very clean. The attendant worked very hard at keeping the tables clean and around the serving dishes picked up. We'll definitely stay here again.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: The Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center
selected_reviews.text: The room smelled musty when we first walked in. Later found large water spot with mildew on bathroom ceiling. When we notified front desk, they just said "oh" . We asked for another room. Hotel needs updating. Rooms are dark and dingy (black carpet?) and small. You literally had to turn around to get into the bathroom. We wanted to upgrade to a larger room, but only standard rooms are pet friendly. With all the choices in Branson, we would not stay here again.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: The Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center
selected_reviews.text: Hotel had NO INTERNET SERVICE ENTIRE WEEK. MOST OF WEEK CABLE & PHONES WERE DOWN, except for inhouse calling. Stay for convention...place was filthy....nothing was clean. breakfast? never saw it...oh unless they mean the old fruit on the table with the juice. The staff couldn't get any dumber. The only business this place to seems to have is the tour buses the elderly travelers take. All 3 bldgs are old and need to be updated.. not with paint either...i mean gutted & refinished completely. The bathroom is so small & dirty you couldn't stand to touch anything in it. I had lysol to clean before we touched anything. The beds were very very nasty.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: The Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center
selected_reviews.text: We spent one night in this hotel because we needed an extra night in Branson at the last minute. The hotel had a very musty smell as soon as you entered. There are no connecting rooms at this hotel which I specifically asked for when I made the reservation and was not told they just didn't have them. The bathroom was seriously smaller than any cruise ship bathroom that I have ever been in. You had to sit sideways on the toilet just to close the door and when you did sit on the toilet the "right" way, the toilet paper holder was poking you in the side. The hotel just did not seem clean at all. The outside does look pretty nice but the rooms inside do not. Also, neither of the pools were working while we were there.

selected_reviews.hotel_name: The Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center
selected_reviews.text: Our room was fine except a little dark. We were on the first floor so we had to keep the drapes shut. The room was nice and clean and for the price it was better than expected for us. The staff was great but the breakfast was not so great but is was good enough. Swimming area was clean and fun and everything you want to see is near this hotel. For the price we paid it was just fine! I would reccomend it to anyone looking for a little budget relief. Nice stay!
